definitions.explanation: A polite demonstrative for direction or location near the listener.
A polite way to refer to the listener or their group/company.

examples.japanese: そちら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
そちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}せて→見せる：01988_miseru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please show me that thing (near you).
Can I get there by train?

examples.japanese: そちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天気|てんき}→天気：00582_tenki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どう→どう：00543_dou⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{降|ふ}っています→降る：00839_furu⟧。
examples.english: How is the weather there? It's raining here today.

examples.japanese: そちら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どなた→どなた：02923_donata⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Who is this? (on the phone, polite)

examples.japanese: そちら⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どちら{様|さま}→どちら：00927_dochira⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
そちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いかが→いかが：02846_ikaga⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
そちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦されています→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How do you do it at your company?

examples.japanese: そちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦お{聞|き}きしたい→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}います→思う：00492_omou⟧。⟦ぜひ→ぜひ：00911_zehi⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I would like to hear your opinion as well. Please tell me.

notes:
そちら is a polite demonstrative pronoun belonging to the こ・そ・あ・ど system. It is the polite form of ⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧/⟦そっち→そっち：02908_socchi⟧ and refers to things near the listener.

FUNCTIONS:
1. Direction/location: "that way" or "there" (near the listener)
2. Person/side: "you" or "your side" (polite reference to the listener)

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- ⟦そっち→そっち：02908_socchi⟧: casual (used among friends)
- そちら: polite/formal (standard polite speech, business)

KO-SO-A-DO SET:
- ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧: this way / I, we (speaker's side)
- そちら: that way / you (listener's side)
- ⟦あちら→あちら：00913_achira⟧: over there / that person (third party)
- ⟦どちら→どちら：00927_dochira⟧: which way / who (question)

BUSINESS USAGE:
In business contexts, そちら often refers to the other party's company or organization. そちら⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧ means "your company" in polite business speech.
